name: v4.12.0
body:
Review and audit findings are numbered now, so you can answer "fix 2 and 4" instead of quoting lines back. CodeBuddy runs ponytail through the existing Claude plugin, and `/ponytail-gain` shows the honest agentic benchmark averages (54% less code, 22% fewer tokens, 20% lower cost, 27% faster, safety kept) instead of the old single-shot numbers a chatty baseline inflated. The README got slimmer too: every per-agent install step now lives in INSTALL.md.

## What's Changed
* docs: add Qwen Code support by @Dattuog in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/888
* feat: CodeBuddy support via the existing Claude plugin (#854) by @ShantanuTaro in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/891
* feat: add Goose adapter docs and schema guard (#880) by @nolanchic in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/882
* docs: add Muse Code CLI support by @dangtrungan in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/950
* docs: note that /ponytail-review takes a target in plain words by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1023
* feat: number review and audit findings (#327) by @yashrao2607 in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/523
* docs: new skills come from the maintainer, ideas go in an issue by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1024
* docs: slim the README, move per-agent install steps to INSTALL.md by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1026
* docs: name the only official install sources in the README by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1027
* test: skip the /bin/sh hook checks where there is no /bin/sh by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1028
* fix(gain): show the agentic benchmark averages, not the old single-shot medians by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1029
* fix(bench): report the real error from correctness checks by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1030
* chore: release v4.12.0 by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1031

## New Contributors
* @Dattuog made their first contribution in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/888

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/compare/v4.11.0...v4.12.0
